text:
Marta: Quick flag for managers about late review submissions: starting this cycle we'll close forms on 06/21 at 5pm PT and lock the repo. Any submissions after that will require a "late submission" note + approval from People Ops. Please ACK.
Devon: is there a grace period for managers who are still collecting evidence? we have a few teams with late customer deliveries.
Marta: grace policy in the packet: 48h grace for documented delays (prod incidents, approved travel). Beyond that, you must submit a Late_Submission_Request to people-ops@redwood with the reason and expected completion date. People Ops triages and either approves or assigns interim reviewer.
Rhea: how does late submission affect comp / calibration scheduling? I don't want someone to miss comp banding because the form showed up late.
Marta: good question. If approved late requests come in before calibration week starts, they will be included in calibration. If not approved before calibration starts, the candidate will be evaluated in the next calibration window (and comp changes deferred). We recommend managers avoid last-minute pushes.
Tom: what about probationary hires (first 90 days)? do they follow same flow?
Marta: probationary ICs use a shortened form (Probation_Review.docx) and are excluded from standard promotion band consideration. Their reviews are advisory for calibration; see p.7 for details.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder: Export of review data (for calibration chairs) will occur on 06/22 09:00 PT. Export will include reviewer notes, evidence links, and recommended band. PHI/PII fields are redacted.
Devon: what fields are redacted? We need to know for legal and compensation ops.
Marta: redacted fields: personal contact info (phone, home address), bank details, and free-text references to protected characteristics. Manager notes should avoid PII. The export will still include performance evidence links and timestamps.
Rhea: can managers preview the export for their teams? sometimes wording in notes gets unintentionally sensitive.
Marta: yes we're offering a one-time "preview export" on 06/20 for managers to review redactions. Submit a request to people-ops@redwood by 06/18.
Tom: any change to calibration training this year? new chairs?
Marta: calibration chairs: same group but added two new senior IC reps for broader perspective. Also mandatory 45-min calibration facilitation training on 06/17 11:00-11:45 for managers attending calibration. Recording available.
Devon: last thing any penalty for missing mandatory training?
Marta: if manager is a calibration attendee and misses the mandatory training, they cannot participate in live calibration and must submit written input ahead of the meeting; repeat misses escalate to Director.
PeopleOpsBot: Also: auto-reminders will run at 72h, 24h, and 4h before close.
Rhea: ACK. I'll circulate this to my managers and book the preview export if needed.
Devon: ACK. I'll block time for the training.
Tom: ACK.
